sources.title: Trajectory Prediction for Autonomous Driving: Progress, Limitations ...
sources.snippet: To accurately predict trajectories, the prediction model must account for the motion of vehicles, cyclists, pedestrians — all traffic participants. For vehicle motion, autonomous vehicles (AV) should be able to track surrounding vehicles and their potential maneuvers.

sources.title: TrajLearn: Trajectory Prediction Learning using Deep Generative Models
sources.snippet: Trajectory prediction aims to estimate an entity's future path using its current position and historical movement data, benefiting fields like autonomous navigation, robotics, and human movement analytics.
